comments_not_self_parent_chk.name: comments_not_self_parent_chk
comments_not_self_parent_chk.value: parent_id is null or parent_id <> id

post_media_video_duration_chk.name: post_media_video_duration_chk
post_media_video_duration_chk.value: kind <> 'video' or (duration_s is not null and duration_s > 0)

post_media_poster_chk.name: post_media_poster_chk
post_media_poster_chk.value: (poster_incoming_key is null) = (poster_mime is null) and (poster_incoming_key is null) = (poster_size_bytes is null)

posts_text_length_chk.name: posts_text_length_chk
posts_text_length_chk.value: text is null or char_length(text) between 1 and 280

posts_caption_chk.name: posts_caption_chk
posts_caption_chk.value: caption is null or (type <> 'text' and char_length(caption) <= 2200)

posts_published_at_ms_chk.name: posts_published_at_ms_chk
posts_published_at_ms_chk.value: published_at is null or published_at = date_trunc('milliseconds', published_at)

reports_target_chk.name: reports_target_chk
reports_target_chk.value:
(target_type = 'post' and comment_id is null)
        or (target_type = 'comment' and post_id is null)
        or (target_type = 'account' and post_id is null and comment_id is null)

reports_details_chk.name: reports_details_chk
reports_details_chk.value: details is null or char_length(details) between 1 and 500

notifications_new_followers_anonymous_ch.name: notifications_new_followers_anonymous_chk
notifications_new_followers_anonymous_ch.value: type <> 'new_followers' or (actor_id is null and post_id is null and comment_id is null and payload = '{}'::jsonb)

notifications_actor_chk.name: notifications_actor_chk
notifications_actor_chk.value: type = 'new_followers' or actor_id is not null

notifications_not_self_chk.name: notifications_not_self_chk
notifications_not_self_chk.value: actor_id is null or actor_id <> recipient_id
